name: @repo/ai-response
description: Streaming assistant text where words animate in as they arrive, with a caret that rides the last glyph and inline citation pills.

useCases: Streaming answer in a chat thread
Any token-by-token text that should not read as a typewriter
compositionHints: Pass the growing text on every render — only new words animate
Mark citations inline as [1], [2] and pass a matching citations array
Set isStreaming to show the caret, clear it when the stream ends
